sentences.text: Podcast episode learning English with Emily.
Episode how to speak English in a restaurant level.
Today we will learn how to speak English in a restaurant.
Going to a restaurant is fun, but it can be difficult if you don't know what to say.
In this episode, I will teach you one, how to enter a restaurant and get a table.
Two, how to order food and drinks.
Three, how to ask for the bill and pay.
I will also give you some useful words and phrases to help you.
When you go to a restaurant, a waiter or waitress will welcome you.
Then they will ask, how many people.
This means how many people are with you.
We have a reservation under the name, your name, if you booked a table.
Then the waiter will say, follow me.
Now you sit down and look at the menu.
Appetizers, small starters, main courses, big meals, drinks, water, juice, coffee, etc.
If you don't understand the menu, you can ask, what do you recommend?
The waiter will explain the food to you.
After a few minutes, the waiter will ask, are you ready to order?
If you need more time, you can say, no, not yet.
If you are ready to order, you can say, yes, I would like a pizza please.
Can I have a chicken sandwich please?
For drinks, you can say, I would like a lemonade please.
Can I have a coffee please?
The waiter may ask, would you like anything else?
Would you like a side dish?
Yes, I would like some fries too.
Then the waiter will say, okay, your food will be ready soon.
When the waiter brings your food, they will say, here is your food.
If you need something, you can call the waiter by saying, excuse me.
You can ask, can I have some salt please?
Can I get some more water please?
The waiter will say, of course, here you go.
If you like the food, you can say, this is delicious.
If something is wrong, you can say, excuse me, my food is cold.
I'm sorry, but I ordered chicken, not fish.
The waiter will help you, asking for the bill in pain.
When you finish eating, you can ask for the bill.
Can I have the bill please?
Can I get the check please?
The waiter will say, of course, here is your bill.
You can ask, can I pay by credit card?
The waiter will say, yes, we accept credit cards.
Yes, you can pay with cash or card.
After you pay, you can say, thank you.
The waiter will say, you too.
Before we finish, here are some important words to remember.
Can I have the bill please?
Practice these words and phrases so you can order food easily.
Now you know how to order food in a restaurant.
Try using these phrases in real life.
Don't be afraid to speak English.
